data.purpose: v25 RK3588S learned new-observation pose research; original VGGT default unchanged.
data.conclusion: No candidate is verified to meet RK3588S 20 Hz and 2–5-second dense-map goals. Among the small learned-pose candidates compared here, DPVO has the smallest checkpoint-verified inference parameter count. Removing CUDA dependencies and measuring the dynamic operations are the immediate research gates; this is not a completed model port or a production replacement.

candidates.name: DPVO / DPV-SLAM (without classical loop closure)
candidates.architecture: Learned CNN features + sparse patch recurrent correspondence/confidence + bundle adjustment. Produces an up-to-scale camera trajectory and sparse reconstruction, not dense VGGT output.

checkpoint.proof: HEAD + complete ZIP central-directory via64KiB suffix;128KiB prefix contains full19226B torch metadata pickle. No complete model download.

license.checkpoint: Official release linked by repository; archive directory contains only dpvo.pth. No separate weight license/model card identified. Code MIT must not be presented as independently verified rights for the checkpoint or compiled derivative.

indoor_evidence.scope: Author GPU results, not our RK measurement; monocular evaluation uses trajectory scale alignment, not metric scale recovery.

published_runtime.critical_caveat: DPVO paper EuRoC protocol explicitly skips every other input image and says this doubles effective reported FPS. Neither GPU rate nor final recovered trajectory measures each fresh source-frame inference on RK3588S.

candidates.blocking_portability: Official import and online tensors are CUDA-specific; cuda_corr, cuda_ba and scatter reductions are outside a straightforward fixed ONNX/RKNN neural graph.
candidates.backend_compatibility: SE3/up-to-scale sparse graph differs from VGGT SL4 projective dense submaps. A new measured and validated bridge is required.

research_contract.scope: Independent research probe; does not replace VGGT, implement a conventional tracker, or claim complete VO timing.

official_imports.entry: from dpvo.net import VONet; from dpvo.dpvo import DPVO
obstacles: net.py imports fastba, altcorr, lietorch and torch_scatter even for neural-only construction.
dpvo.py creates CUDA SE3 identity at import and hard-codes CUDA allocations.
Official complete package cannot run unchanged on RK3588S; isolated module import/refactoring and exact operators must be disclosed.

weights.released_dtype: FP32 FloatStorage for all 98 metadata entries
weights.prefix_rule: Strip module. exactly as official loader; reject any duplicate result key.
weights.requirement: Only these four legacy lmbda tensors may be excluded because official current code explicitly excludes them. Require exact key/shape/dtype coverage and a newly computed full artifact SHA after an authorized complete download. No strict=False/random missing weights.
weights.metadata_inspection: Restricted pickle metadata only from a bounded 128 KiB ZIP prefix; no torch import, tensor storage loading, model construction, or forward.

encoder.input: One actual new source image [1,1,3,H,W], BGR for official TUM reader; source uint8 range0..255 converted to floating 2*(image/255)-0.5 exactly. Do not substitute VGGT RGB normalization.
encoder.feature_scale: Each encoder output divided by4.0 in Patchifier.
encoder.layers: Twin BasicEncoder4: Conv7 stride2, two32-channel residual blocks, two64-channel residual blocks (first stride2), Conv1 output128/384. fnet uses InstanceNorm2d without learned affine parameters; inet uses no norm. ReLU/residual unchanged.
encoder.calls_per_new_source: Exactly one fnet and one inet extraction per incoming frame, including initialization frames that later receive no pose.

static_mac.basis: Integer formula from actual source conv sizes, NOT a measurement. Excludes normalization, correlation, patch extraction, updater, BA, I/O, and memory costs. Smaller resolution is a research change and has no indoor accuracy proof.

patch_and_update.warning: Actual config/default.yaml overrides Python initial defaults; do not report80 as the paper/default96 setup.
patch_and_update.update_equation: Add context and correlation MLP; LN eps1e-3; masked temporal neighbor FC additions; two grouped SoftAgg updates; two LN+gated residual units; independent2D residual and sigmoid confidence heads.
patch_and_update.dynamic_ops: fastba.neighbors(kk,jj), torch.unique/group inverse, scatter_softmax and scatter_sum; E and memberships change with current factor graph.
patch_and_update.safe_static_probe: A fixed synthetic or board-captured E/edge graph can measure the complete neural update only if neighbor/group operations retain exact semantics. Naive zero-padding edges corrupts grouped softmax. Stage split CPU+NPU must include every gather/scatter/transfer in end-to-end timing.
patch_and_update.calls_per_source: Before initialization motion_probe calls one Update for each attempted frame with n>0; at eight accepted frames initialization calls update12 times. Steady state calls update once, each with correlation plus two BA iterations. terminate adds12 updates and must be excluded from fresh-output rates but included in total shutdown time.

npu_candidate_ops: Fixed CNN Conv/Relu/Add; InstanceNorm as explicit exact reductions subject to compiler and runtime evidence; fixed row FC/MatMul, LN, sigmoid. No RKNN support claim until actual target profile.
cpu_or_new_kernel_work: Random patch coordinates and patch sampling
Geometry projection/SE3 exp-log and motion initialization
Dynamic bilinear correlation (two feature scales,7x7 neighborhood)
Temporal neighbor and grouped scatter reductions
Block-sparse BA, with2 iterations per update

state.poses: World-to-camera internal SE3; published terminate() poses are inverse c2w, xyz+xyzw.
state.patch_depth: Inverse-depth sparse3x3 patches, not dense depth.
state.graph: Dynamic ii/jj/kk edges, per-edge384 hidden state, changing target/weights, sliding optimization window and retained removed-frame relations.
state.limits: N=BUFFER_SIZE default4096 poses; source explicitly raises on overflow. Proximity/global options introduce additional retention, so bounded feature ring does not prove an arbitrarily long total memory bound.

no_orb_required_config.LOOP_CLOSURE: False for first VO probe; optional learned proximity=True later, without classical mode.
no_orb_required_config.no_conventional_frontend: Random sparse learned patches, recurrent correspondence and BA are the authors learned algorithm, not ORB/LK/PnP. Still a different architecture/checkpoint from original VGGT.

research_contract.measurement_acceptance: Record source timestamps, actual network/BA calls, initialization gaps, new observed-frame pose publication, all failures and CPU/NPU stage time. Never count terminate() recovered poses or motion-model-only initialization as actual freshly inferred poses. For20Hz, steady source period is50ms;100ms latency allowance is not a100ms per-frame throughput budget.
research_contract.dense_mapping_and_vggt_bridge: DPVO has no dense map/inferred intrinsics. Adding it to VGGT requires a separately validated scale/gauge/SL4 bridge; no rigid pose composition through arbitrary SL4. This probe does not prove2-5s map updates.

candidates.name: TartanVO
candidates.architecture: Two-image PWC-Net dense-flow pyramid -> camera-intrinsics channels -> learned residual PoseNet. No ORB/LK/PnP and no BA in its learned forward.

checkpoint.availability_limits: Author Box HEAD404; Azure mirror DNS unresolved on current network. Author Drive folder exposes file name/size; complete download and SHA not verified.

license.checkpoint: No separate weight license/model card independently identified; do not infer artifact grant from code label alone.

inputs_outputs.image_pair: Two B3x448x640 images with dimensions multiple64, official optical flow at112x160.
inputs_outputs.intrinsics: Two per-pixel calibration ray channels, transformed consistently with crop/flow scale.
inputs_outputs.outputs: Quarter-resolution flow plus6D motion; NED convention, translation up-to-scale, no dense depth/inferred K/pose confidence.

indoor_evidence.training: TartanAir simulation; authors report indoor/outdoor real-data generalization without finetuning.

candidates.GT_boundary: GT is optional benchmark input, not a required network condition. If pose-file supplies motion, TartanVO.py explicitly replaces predicted per-frame translation magnitude using GT norm. Research must omit this input, preserve raw predicted scale, and evaluate with disclosed post-hoc trajectory alignment only.
candidates.portability: Conv/deconv/FC portion may suit fixed graph. Five levels of CuPy correlation, four grid_sample warps and threshold mask are essential inference operations; CPU correlation explicitly raises NotImplementedError and warp mask hardcodes.cuda(). A mathematically verified CPU/newNPU equivalent is required before the complete checkpoint can run on RK.
candidates.next_step: Lower priority than DPVO: only consider isolated PoseNet+one true correlation/warp level feasibility. PoseNet-only fast output with supplied flow is not complete camera pose inference.

candidates.name: Monodepth2 odometry checkpoint
candidates.disposition: Cheap convolutional feasibility control; not selected for indoor SLAM integration.
candidates.architecture: Separate ResNet18 depth encoder/decoder and6-channel two-image pose encoder/Conv PoseDecoder. No learned uncertainty or joint geometric optimization in inference.

license.code: Niantic Monodepth2 noncommercial license, patent pending; NOT MIT/BSD/Apache
license.checkpoint: Author release is linked by README; no independent artifact-specific license established beyond this noncommercial repository notice.

candidates.indoor_evidence: Only KITTI odometry/depth evaluation established in inspected primary release; no released indoor-trained model or TUM validation identified.
candidates.output_semantics: Dense disparity/depth and pairwise axis-angle/translation, but no confidence/shared global metric scale/loop graph. KITTI evaluation aligns5-frame snippets to GT scale; that is not a metric or long-trajectory guarantee.
candidates.portability: Convolutions, normalization, ELU/ReLU, resize/padding and sigmoid are a much simpler static graph than Transformers. Official evaluate_pose.py still calls.cuda(); CPU adaptation can use standard Torch ops but has not been measured. No RK20Hz claim.
candidates.published_runtime: No whole depth+pose RK or attributable inference benchmark verified in inspected source; do not turn its TitanXp training setup into an inference-speed claim.

deprioritized.name: Native VGGT tracking head
deprioritized.reason: Original forward still calls full aggregator before tracker; head predicts2D tracks/visibility/confidence, not a lightweight new-camera6DoF incremental branch. Deriving poses using PnP would violate this task restriction.

deprioritized.name: R3 / CUT3R
deprioritized.reason: Public causal candidates exist, but retain large per-image encoders and require different learned checkpoints. The next experiment prioritizes a smaller per-frame network. No RK3588S 20 Hz result is established.

deprioritized.name: OTT3R / Mem3R
deprioritized.reason: Inspected author README did not provide a directly downloadable complete pretrained pose/depth student artifact; generic encoder weights and train-local last.ckpt are not enough.

deprioritized.name: FastVGGT / SwiftVGGT
deprioritized.reason: Training-free long-sequence/chunk reconstruction optimizations are not proof of20Hz new-observation pose for two-image submaps. FastVGGT README evaluates1000images; SwiftVGGT uses chunk/overlap processing and single-Sim3 alignment instead ofIRLS. Do not extrapolate headline4x or33% total time to the current short submap.

one_next_executable_research_experiment.candidate: DPVO original released weights, independent CNN+update probe
one_next_executable_research_experiment.reason: Only3.384M inference parameters and13.1MB public archive with verified complete state metadata, plus real indoor evidence; the most concrete low-compute learned alternative identified.
one_next_executable_research_experiment.authorization_boundary: Proposed isolated research. No complete checkpoint download, candidate board inference or production replacement has occurred.
steps: Download the official 13.1 MB archive, retain HTTP provenance and full SHA, and apply exactly the 94-inference-key loading contract.

Port only standard fnet/inet forward and neural Update with exact captured dynamic neighbor/group results; establish a board CPU FP32 numerical reference before compiling fixedCNN/FC components. No optional dependency stubs can stand in for active inference.

Run one fixed original image resolution/pinned indoor source with board-only CPU reference and RKNN candidates, actual target profiles, owned outputs and stage errors. Use fullweights and all normalizations/biases.

Measure true sampling/correlation/scatter/SE3/BA CPU closure separately. A fast CNN result alone cannot justify learned VO20Hz. If complete CPU/newkernel closure exceeds50ms steady period or fails accuracy/pose freshness, stop before fullintegration.

Only after full fresh-frame learned-VO evidence should a no-ORB proximity-loop and dense-VGGT scale/projective bridge be evaluated. Replacing the default model remains a distinct architecture decision.
